reason: Anycubic Slicer Next and an equivalent local slicer executable are not installed in the validation environment.
required_user_checks: Open all three core 3MF files in Anycubic Slicer Next.
Confirm one direct catcher object and upright full logos on front, left and display/right faces.
Confirm five material assignments and no auto-arrangement of fallback STL parts.
Inspect every layer for open inlet/outlet, two vertical mounting slots, continuous 1.0 mm side skin, solid impact wall and inward hood.
Record sliced time, filament and purge-waste estimates.
release_effect: Blocks destination-slicer and physical release gates.
